title: Morwalo wa Dikhumo
intro: O eme fa pele ga kgang ya khumo e e seng kana ka sepe, botshelo jo bo kgabisitsweng ka gauta le maatla, mme lefa go ntse jalo kwa bofelong e le thuto e e tlhagisang botlhe ba ba batlang bogolo jwa lefatshe. A o ka kgona go tlhalosa gore motho yono yo kgang ya gagwe e boelelang mo nakong e ntse e tsamaya ke mang, e leng bosupi jwa gore dithoto tsa lefatshe di a feta ka bonako?
clues: Ke ne ke tswa mo bathong ba Moporofeti yo mogolo, mme ke ne ka tlhopha tsela ya boikgogomoso le kgatelelo.
Allah o ne a nnaya khumo e e seng kana ka sepe, mo e leng gore dinotlolo tsa matlotlo a me e ne e le morwalo o o bokete mo setlhopheng se se nonofileng sa banna.
Batho ba me ba ne ba nkgakolola gore ke se ka ka itumelela dikhumo tsa me, ba nkgopotsa gore Allah ga a rate ba ba itumelang.
Ke ne ka bolela ka boikgogomoso gore khumo ya me e kgolo e bakilwe ke kitso ya me le maiteko a me, e seng tshegofatso e e tswang kwa go Allah.
Ke ne ka tlhagisiwa kgatlhanong le bonweenwee mme ka gakololwa gore ke batle Botshelo jwa Morago ga Loso ka se Allah a se nneileng, mme ke ne ka gana go reetsa mme ka tswelela ka boikgogomoso jwa me.
Kgabagare, Allah o ne a dira gore lefatshe le kometse nna le bonno jwa me, a ntlogela ke se na bathusi kgatlhanong le taelo ya Gagwe.
verse: So We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no body of supporters to aid him other than Allah, nor was he of those who could defend themselves. (Al-Qasas 28:81)
arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِ وَبِدَارِهِ الْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُ مِن فِئَةٍ يَنصُرُونَهُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُنتَصِرِينَ
